prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1046; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center section, with the left tail lamp assembly broken and the trunk lid showing a crease along its lower edge. The damage pattern sits well within what would be expected from the reported rear impact, and the panels affected follow the path of force. Repair will consist of replacing the bumper cover and lamp assembly, straightening and refinishing the trunk lid, and recalibrating the parking sensors. The labor hours requested match the scope of these tasks. No prior damage to this vehicle is known to us, and the invoiced items show no repeated charges.
